notes: Only assigned unfinished fields examined. Replication, reported_success, and other unassigned fields are placeholders, not replacement values. Target ambiguous across Table 4 models 1–5. Candidate printed ORs (SE), respectively: 1.025 (0.003), 1.026 (0.003), 1.030 (0.012), 1.028 (0.006), 1.027 (0.006). Same-test star bounds: models 1, 2, 4, 5 p < 0.001; model 3 p < 0.01. Section 4.1 discusses model 1 then says effects persist in models 2–5; the supplied description does not select a model. No candidate is promoted to an extracted value. Common model sample candidate only: Table 4 prints N (Observations) 1620 (540); 540 respondents each contribute a choice among three alternatives, represented by 1620 alternative records. Do not sum these roles. Missing values were multiply imputed (200 imputations); section 3.3.3 identifies 54 missing dependent choices and 38 missing ISEI values. Complete-case simulations and appendix models are distinct; Table 3 gives 441 listwise cases. No N arithmetic or df inference performed.
